title: Scaffold Cargo workspace and crate skeletons
description:
A working Cargo workspace must exist before any crate code can compile or be tested. Create: workspace Cargo.toml ([workspace] with members mime-tree and smime-tree, shared [profile] settings, MSRV 1.75); .gitignore; rustfmt.toml.

mime-tree/Cargo.toml deps:
- mail-parser (RFC 5322/MIME parsing engine, private impl detail)
- encoding_rs (charset conversion)
- base64 (Base64 transfer-decode — do NOT hand-roll)
- quoted_printable (QP transfer-decode — do NOT hand-roll)
- serde with derive feature

smime-tree/Cargo.toml deps:
- cms (CMS/PKCS#7 DER parse+build — do NOT hand-roll DER)
- x509-cert (certificate parsing)
- rsa (RSA key transport)
- p256, p384 (ECDH key agreement)
- x963-kdf (ANSI X9.63 KDF for ECDH in CMS per RFC 5753 — do NOT hand-roll)
- aes-kw (AES key wrap for ECDH KEK — do NOT hand-roll)
- aes + cbc + aes-gcm (content encryption — do NOT hand-roll)
- sha2 (digest)
- rand_core (OsRng for CEK/IV generation — NOT the top-level rand crate; rand_core is the minimal CSPRNG interface used throughout RustCrypto)
- der (DER encoding, transitive from cms but may need explicit dep)
- serde with derive feature
- mime-tree (path dep)

Stub src/lib.rs in each crate.
acceptance_criteria: cargo check --workspace succeeds on a stub lib.rs in each crate
